nom: Peter Thomas Roth Potent-C Vitamin C Power Serum

avis.texte: TL;DR. Packaging opens up and leaks. Product does not stay emulsified and is greasy not silky. Find an alternative Vitamin C. I've purchased this product for years and have noticed changes with time. However, my latest was the last. The packaging is poorly constructed and unscrews constantly. The first package was leaking and I had to return it. The product itself is separates and does not stay emulsified. I have to shake it before I dispense it to mix the oil and creme together, however there are no such instructions on the bottle. It seems the quality of the ingredients have decreased. Really disappointing.

Perfect product BUT you need to sell a refillable insert!!!!! Then it would not be so expensive but i manage to never be without it. But it would be very nice if you would make a refillable insert!! I would have given it a 10 but it needs an refillable insert
It's pricey but definitely worth the cost. I've been using PTR Vitamin C serum for six years and it is my all time favorite. I noticed the difference when I don't use it.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: I recommend the product unless they changed the formula, but the new packaging is terrible. I could not pump the product out of the container. I returned it.

avis.titre: Another out of the park transformer!
avis.texte: I finally tried the PTR C serum. In three days I noticed a difference. My skin felt smoother. I still have some mild sun spots , which will take longer to disappear. I expect that. I just didn't imagine such a difference in under a week!! This is definitely a HIGHLY recommended product!

I loved the old power serum. It was clear and glided on my skin. Whyyyy if you say it's the same product would you not only change the packaging but also the consistency from a clear hydrating serum to a white thicker serum. Do not like the feel. You did the same thing to the wrinkle resist power serum to these white seeums. No longer a fan of this whole new set of serums. They used to make my skin glow. No longer....the consistency is different. On the hunt for new products.

Used to love this product and felt it made a difference in my skin back when the packaging was silver/orange. Purchased and returned two of these (new white/orange packaging) due to the pump not working. I gave up on this and purchased a different brand of vitamin C serum.
I got worst acne when i started using this. Will be returning
The odor of this product line is very unpleasant. I thought that this would be useful for my skin but the odor is offensive. I will be returning for a refund as I cannot use the product.

I have owned a lot of serums throughout my adult life. PTR Potential-C is by far a superior quality than the rest. It starts with the beauty of the bottle itself, the sublime experience of rubbing in the serum. It is exquisite. The light smell and ease of application are divine. The results can be seen almost immediately. I will never use another serum again.
Zero stars. Terrible products bad smelling and no safety seals
This is my 2nd repurchase and it has become my ride or die. So many good benefits for me and have even grown addicted to the scent. Good job, PTR!!!
I bought this product a few months ago and absolutely love its results! Brighter and firmer skin without that yucky vitamin C after smell. It's now my favorite vitamin C serum!
This is by far my favorite face cream in a long time! It makes my skin feel incredibly soft, and it's so lightweight. Since I started using it, my skin has been clearer and brighter than ever.
Best VIT C ever. The results are amazing. Who cares about the smell that disapats in 10 second,, does not bother me one bit when I look in the mirror every day and see youthful results.
Hard to review a product you paid for and NEVER RECEIVED. Customer service won't respond. I thought Peter Thomas Toth was reputable. They've proven they are not. Very unfortunate.
Too soon to tell is I see any difference but my skin does feel nice and smooth. The smell of this product is a little off putting. Not a pleasant scent

Great product Could tell a big difference on my skin after the 1st use! My acne scars are definitely diminished My skin is smoother & lines are less visible The only thing negative is the smell but if it works this well I'll deal with it Thank you PTR for making such good products
I got this for free, was super excited but when I put it on the cheap burnt plasticy smell was so powerful it made me sick. Would not recommend at all.

I thank God I didn't pay full price for this, it didn't help my skin with discoloration, this is just an overpriced moisturizer that smells horrible, truly horrible, like you're burning a cleaning solution with plastic, I have to use it at night, otherwise I'd be smelling it the whole day, I would recommend this to someone I hate.

Most important info for ptr pump products, you must keep pump products upside down to get the most out of them, up to a month more. Other than that I love ptr products!!! I'm 71 and I look great for my age thanks to my PRT regimen.

I haven't been able to use this regularly bc the smell is so overpowering. Like a burnt plastic bag that had an orange in it. I really wanted to like it and push through but my husband even commented on it.

avis.titre: Is this vitam C OIL FREE? is it ok for OILY SKIN?
avis.texte: I'd like to try this serum but I have oily skin and i don't like to have my skin shining after applying it. It usually happens every time that I put my timeless vit c serum on 🤷🏻‍♂️ 😒 Is it oil free vit c??? Is it suitable for oily skin???

I usually use SkinMedica C serum but wanted to try this. It's very silky and smooth, does well under makeup with no pilling at all. My only negative is has a strong scent. It's not a bad scent at all, I am just sensitive to fragrances .

Definite scent, but I rather enjoy it. Does not irritate my skin at all because of the THD form of vitamin c. Not sure if I'm noticing anything obvious from using it, but I expect it will take 6 months or so to notice anything. Will continue to repurchase when it's on sale. It's a bit pricey.
This serum gave my face a rash. It felt like it was burning. Something in it was so irritating to me. I would not recommend it.
It smels like a cheap bacon dog treat & for that reason i find it hard to use consistently

avis.titre: Too expensive for the results achieved, bottle not filled
avis.texte: The serum feels nice but I didn't see changes in fine lines or brightening after three weeks of use. I was also disappointed the bottles aren't filled… I returned the original purchase only to find the replacement also was not filled properly. I don't mind spending $100+ on my face products but I expect to a full bottle especially when it contains only 1fl oz! And as you see the top it the widest point—Consumer Beware!
This product smells like burnt matches. I cant really tell a difference after 2 weeks and 2x daily.
I feel like it leaves my skin smooth using twice a day. I will buy again.Do recommend it .nice feeling.I also use other Peter Thomas Roth products.

Haven't used it long enough to see results. However, l cap believe ultra has discontinued 20% off birthday coupon. To make matters worse they don't have your bday gift instore, so you have to order it & pay shipping!!

avis.titre: Best Vit C lotion with very high amounts of Vit c
avis.texte: I am a believer of Vit C lotion. I am 69 years old with dry skin. This lotion has a high amount of Vit C. I highly recommend it!

I have tried several products from the brand and typically don't get skin irration from products, but this was something else. I got 1000s of tiny bumps all over my face with large splotchy redness. I will have to go back to a gentler vitamin c.

I've wanted to try this serum it went on sale for 21 days of beauty so i was excited to try. It smelled kind of strong but i had never used any ptr products before so i didnt think anything of it my face looked nice and glowy after using then woke up with red blotches and an itchy face i would NOT recommend its not worth the money the concentration is way to high and dangerous to the face if not used appropriately. I will be returning hopefully so will my soft clear skin :(

I also have the Potent C in the jar which smells much worse than this one. It does diminish after a few minutes so definitely give it a try if you are looking for a good vitamin C product. But really, what's up with the stick applicator??? Peter, please add a pump for better dispensing!
I have not had breakouts even as a teenager but this product gave me severe breakouts. Which in tuen have left big blemishes.

I've tried many vitamin C serums and creams and was pleasantly surprised at how wonderful this made my complexion feel and look the following day. I put it on after cleansing and masking in the evening several hours before bed so it can soak/melt in to my skin. A little goes a long way and it spreads very well. It does have a little tingling feeling, however I personally appreciate that, and know it's working. I have very sensitive skin and absolutely no issues with this vitamin C cream.

I've been buying this for a while, love the way it feels and the way it looks. It does wonders for my skin tone, the "look" of elasticity, and was pleasantly surprised by the pore blurring! However, for the past 2 orders, I've had delivery or packaging issues. The first one came with a broken pump, so I just transferred to my old one and called it a day. The latest one however came half opened and spilled everywhere, which meant much of the product was gone already. I tightened it and figured I'd deal with it upon return so I packed it and left now tell me how it opened AGAIN and spilled into my leather toiletry bag — which is impossible to clean by the way. Disappointed in the packaging. I want to recommend but not if a good product is unusable due to faulty packaging…
Greasy, burned my skin. Had an awful reaction and not the first item from this company to do this.
Greasy and made my face burn. Had a horrible reaction to the ingredients. Not the first time with Peter Thomas Roth products. Same with vitamin c under eye treatment as well.
yes it smells like smoked meat, but it's still worth every penny! got rid of my melasma and my skin is super bright and youthful! will purchase again and again!
Im 63, This vitamin C serum plumps my dry lines.I hope to never be without it
Smells like a peice of smoked meat log in a christmas gift basket they would have in cracker barrel that expired in 2005.

I do not normally have sensitive skin. This product caused my face to blister with a rash. My entire face and neck turned bright red and felt like it was burning. I returned it immediately. Hopefully my skin clears up soon.
I love this vitamin C. The price was just about 80USD months ago. I'm a little heartbroken becaue of it, hope product remains original because I stand by it.
It's been a month and everything was fine with this product. But when I pumped it out today to apply it was inconsistent and there was watery discharge (look at the picture)

Holy smokes this stuff is amazing. I tried it once a day (in the AM) for 3-4 weeks and didn't see any results, so I put it in a drawer and forgot about it. Pulled it out again recently and forced myself to finish it because it wasn't cheap. I used it twice a day instead of once, hoping to move through it quickly so I could try a product I was more excited about… but THAT was the game changer. Within two weeks of using it both in the AM and the PM my skin is so much brighter and firmer and plumper. I could not be more impressed and will be re-purchasing. Lesson learned: find a workhorse serum and use it twice a day to maximize results versus having 2 different serums that you use once a day (except, of course, retinol and exfoliants… don't mess with those multiple times a day). Yes it smells funky, like most vitamin C products do, but the results are worth it. I also have sensitive skin and this has not bothered me or triggered my perioral dermatitis. I just have to be careful not to put very much of it around my mouth/chin and I'm good to go.
Good Product for me~~ I like this product ~ recommand for you

avis.titre: I will never stop buying this product
avis.texte: On a recent Vist to my derm she said whatever your using now don't stop. Your skin is amazing!! I was using Peter Thomas Roth vitamin C serum.
I'd give this 5 stars, if it wasn't so expensive. It absorbs well and gives my skin a healthy glow. It does have a fragrance, but I actually like the smell.
It's really hard to use, because it smells like charred hotdogs. I'm too distracted by the smell to give this an honest shot.
I have tried many vitamin C serums and this is by far the best! It works well with my sensitive skin and has shown a definite improvement in my skin.
I have no idea if this works, but the smell alone made me toss the free sample. If you like chai smell mixed with chemical undertones, then this might work for you.

I got this as a sample. The smell alone completely turned me off. And the worst part is that it does not dissipate like other stinky things may do. I don't even know if it will work. It went right into the trash.
This is one of the more expensive products I find myself repurchasing! I have very sensitive/eczema prone skin and this does not irritate it at all. All you need is one pump!

It literally broke my face out after one application. I have hives all over my face I used just once and returned it. I have very small areas of hyperpigmentation that I wanted to clear up this was suggested by an Ulta representative.
I keep trying to get past the smell of this product but it's so hard. The smell is just awful.
The packaging for this horrible. Should be able to dispense easily. The wand is flimsy and serves no purpose.

Got this upon a recommendation of one of the sales people instead of my normal sunday riley vitamin C. This is a MIRACLE in a bottle. NOW, at first I was going to take it back because I thought it was too strong and irritating. But after a few days my skin adjusted and fell in love!!!!!! My skin is simply glowing :)
I got a sample and had to wash it off almost immediately after applying it, the smell was so bad. Very harsh and chemical-like. It also felt greasy going on.

I have been using this serum for a month or so. I mainly purchased it to help me reduce the dark spots on my face. I have noticed that my dark spots are getting lighter. My pores seem smaller and my complexion looks more radiant. I would purchase again.

avis.titre: Not enough product for the price
avis.texte: Just the title, and the pump has a lot of trouble working with like a quarter of product left. Used two pumps, and it didn't last very long. I would need much more product for the price.

I have normal to dry sensitive skin. This is an absolute no for me. The smell is so strong of orange peel and cinnamon(?) it should have been an indicator that this was not going to work for me. The consistency is nice when it comes out combined but it has separation issues. Very hydrating feeling but it broke me out horribly on my cheeks. This might be a product for more mature skin as I'm only 28 and this is very heavy. Thank goodness it was just a sample size but I'm going to stick with caudalie's vitamin c alternative.

I received this cute little 2 ml sample and was so excited to try it. I applied it to my clean dry face and had to almost immediately wash it off. It smells like the serum was in a warehouse fire. Like smoke and burnt oranges. This product is completely unusable. Disappointing.

This smells like straight up BBQ sauce. You will constantly smell it on your face and hands. For the price I would not recommend. I can't wear it any time I plan on being around someone close range. I never write reviews, but this had to be said.

I bought this product two months ago knowing it would have a strong smell, which didn't bother me. In the past couple weeks, I noticed that the texture and consistency of the product changed. It used to come out as a white serum and now it comes out as a greasy clear liquid with speckles of white. I tried to shake the bottle to mix the product, but that didn't help. I contacted support at Peter Thomas Roth, but they didn't provide an explanation or solution for this. They just recommended returning it.

I received this as a sample and was excited to try it. First of all, the smell is terrible. I have never had any skin care smell like the funky smell this product has. Most importantly though, I had a terrible reaction to this. My face is covered in small bumps, is itchy and burns. I typically do not have sensitive skin either. BUYER BEWARE!

I picked this up in the recent 50% off sale. I like it much better than I thought I would. It's hydrating, but since I've been using Vitamin C products for years I can't see a difference yet in that aspect. It does have a strong, very strange smell, though. While I don't hate it per se, it reminds me of hot dogs cooking over a campfire, which makes me almost want hot dogs and miss camping! I don't even like hot dogs! Lol

As an individual with aged and sun damaged skin, I have to say I am extremely happy with this purchase and glad I decided to try during Ulta's 21 days of beauty offers. I will definitely want to purchase again. This Vitamin C concentrate has worked incredibly fast at decreasing discoloration and has visibly improved elasticity of skin. While the oder of the ferulic acid may be off putting to some, I really do think that the combination of ingredients is what makes this product work so well and it is well worth getting accustomed to. The oder does fade after a while. I highly recommend this product
I have purchased this product for a while now but there seems to have been a formulation change that has left the product less potent.

This product smells absolutely awful, I got it to try during the 21 days of beauty sale and I'm so glad I didn't pay full price. It makes my face smell like sewage. There is also the design of the bottle, it's not a pump or a squeeze dropper, it's just a stick that picks up a tiny amount of product that you touch directly to your face, so it will pick up bacteria easily. Terrible design, terrible smell, overpriced, but the product itself works well. Just not worth the other aspects.

I saw an improvement in the first week. I'm 74 years old and a sun lover....my skin is brighter...the 1 age spot has not disappeared (I was hoping that it would). But my skin is firmer and the fine lines are appreciably reduced. I am absolutely amazed!

I have sensitive skin and so when my skin loves something, I stick with it. It's expensive so I was excited to see it in the Ulta 21 Days of Beauty Sale again. Yes, I stocked up. I go through a bottle of this in about two and a half months. It hydrates and smooths my skin as well as evens my complexion. It works well with my other skincare products.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again.
avis.texte: I've been using this product (AM & PM) for over a week now and OMG I can see a big difference on my face. I'm 52 yrs old and the visible lines on my forehead and underneath my eyes are looking so much smoother and are hardly visible now. My skin looks radiant. I love this product !!!
Makes your skin glow! Now a new staple, AM & PM. Wasn't sure about the scent but it doesn't last long.

I literally washed the product off my face less than 30 seconds after applying it because of the overwhelming smell of fertilizer. Maybe the product works wonders—if so, I'll never know because I refuse to leave something on my face that smells like it should be used on a lawn. I will be returning product this promptly.
I have 5 days with it and of course that it works. I saw a lot of reviews about the smell. But to be honest for me it doesn't matter the smell for me the important is to have the results.
I have 5 days with it and of course that it works. I saw a lot of reviews about the smell. But to be honest for me it doesn't matter the smell for me the important is to have the results.

When I first got this I was a little unsure. The product was not what I was expecting. It's heavy at first and has a different consistency, it's not really a serum or lotion. Also to note, the product is unscented. So it doesn't smell the best because there is no fake fragrance. I have now been using this about 2 weeks and have started to really love it. It takes about 15 minutes to fully absorb into your skin and It feels so hydrating and makes me feel glowy. I feel like I'm at a spa when I use it. It's thick on your skin at first but sinks in so nicely. I love the way it feels and the instant glow. I haven't noticed any difference with fine lines or dark spots.

Extremely disappointed. PTR used to be my go to favorite, especially this serum. The formula has changed it is is nothing like it used to be!!! It was like a completely different product. Also gave me a rash all over my face and I had to return.

Yes, this stuff is pretty pricey, but that's the only "bad" thing about it. I previously used a similar serum by a different brand that had a very strong and unpleasant smell on top of being sticky and runny. This product, however, doesn't smell great, but it's not bad. It is also a cream consistency, so it is easy to use and doesn't leave my face sticky. Plus, it works so well! Definitely recommend!
A little greasy for my liking. I'll stick with the water drench line.

avis.titre: I will not buy this product again
avis.texte: I used an entire bottle as directed and saw no results. I have 2 brown spots on one side of my face and there was not any noticeable difference.

avis.titre: C / E / Ferulic Acid on crack!
avis.texte: This stuff is legit! It's not love at first sight but once you passed that distinct smell in the beginning you just unlock your Holy Grail. Not everyone's cup of tea but if your skin is lucky, this will be your weapon of choice every night.

Let's see I have been using this product for about 6 months now and I love it. I'm Hispanic and in my younger years, I would have said I had oily skin. I live in N.VA and noticed this last winter my skin was dry and old looking. I was pregnant and on the cusp of 40 years old. My skin was in absolute shambles. I wanted a autumn but a lotion type that would provide some moisture as well. I finally broke down and bought this one. First time I used it the smell caught me off guard. For a lot of people it might smell not so great but I love the smell of cloves and that is what it smells like to me. It also made my face tingle the first few weeks but I got used to that and enjoy the feeling now. I have somewhat sensitive skin and turn red from almost everything, not this. No negative reaction from it at all. My skin is smooth and youthful looking again. Love this product and will continue buying it.

avis.titre: Vitamin C Serum is a must
avis.texte: I can only think think staves off and helps brown spots and fine wrinkles as my skin looks better than it did 5 years ago when I started using it and I always forget to wear sunscreen and Im out and about outside at least 3-4 hours a day walking around the city! I highly recommend it!

Been using this for appx 1 year. Love the way my skin looks after I put it on. Not irritating, very hydrating. I feel it is definitely preventing new wrinkles and helping keep the ones I already have from worsening.

I wanna be perfectly honest by stating that I haven't seen the amazing results that are pictured on the box but I'm significantly younger than the target demographic so that might be why. My skin needed zero adjustment to the products and they have a very light scent that is not overwhelming. Like a hint of orange maybe? This is my third bottle and I'll continue to use it religiously and hopefully stay looking young.

Big fan here. I have been using this serum for over a year and can tell a huge difference in the texture and brightness of my skin, and it really keeps the fine lines hidden. It is heavy enough to keep my skin moist in the winter, but light enough that it doesn't cause me to break out in the summer.
This serum brightens my skin, helps smooth it out. If I miss a day, I can see it in my skin.

avis.titre: I will continue to build my line of PTR.
avis.texte: I use this product daily (twice a day). Religiously. Love this product and all PTR products I use and have purchased.

The store clerk highly recommended it to reduce sunspots. I used it everyday religiously, day and night and it just did not work at all. I wanted to believe in this product especially for the price I paid. I love other Peter Roth products but sadly this was not one of them. Keep your money.

Just ordered this. Did not realize that it's a screw on top. It loosens. I like to keep my counter neat. Spilled more than half of it all over my bathroom drawer. Should have a label Keep Upright. It's also a little grainy. Too early to rate actual product. But then again, I'm almost out.

I use this product in the AM in combination with Ordinary's Alpha Arbutin -also SUNSCREEN. These photos were taken 3 weeks apart. I have tried so many different Vitamin C products and even prescription product with no result

I've been using the serum for three days straight can't say much yet but I'm positive for the outcome. I started using the cleanser, by seeing the drastic change of my oily skin I'm sure the product of Peter Roth Thomas is one of the best products that I've purchased is pricey but worth every penny.

avis.titre: I like this Peter Thomas Roth skin care product
avis.texte: I use this Potent C Power Serum at night and I like the way it hydrates my skin and helps reduce dark spots and appearance of fine lines. Others have complained about the fragrance, but for a clinical grade product, I did not find the fragrance offensive. It is expensive, so I try to wait for a sale or double points days to purchase.
This is the first vitamin c product that has irritated my skin. Pleasantly surprised. 😃

I have used almost the whole tube . I use it morning and night . It had a small effect on my dark spots . It may work better with continued use. I have only tried one other product for dark spots and this did have a better result.
Love it - saw a difference in my skin quickly. My skin was smoother and brighter after a week of use.

I know lots of reviews saying it smells bad, it doesn't, the smell it does have barely lasts 10 seconds. I could notice a difference in my pores the next day after use. When I use this every night of the week my skin looks amazing. And won't have any breakouts. Hate that it is so expensive though but now that I have it i don't think id switch to anything else

avis.titre: Expense but a must for Me
avis.texte: after 5 days of daily use I noticed 1 of my acne scars (the darkest) become visibly lighter then I started to notice the other scars become visible lightly. after it's been 2 months and my scars are almost gone. Will def repurchase
Wonderful product and surprisingly gentle on my skin and I am a redhead with sensitive skin. I see improvement with two weeks of use.
Excellent product - well worth the money - a smoothing fluid that leaves skin looking healthy

I have used many vitamin C products, and I always come back to this one. I am probably on my 6th bottle. I love how it makes my skin feel and I can see visible results. Instantly my skin is brightened and with long term use I can see lines smoothed and less acne. I have been using the serum in the morning. I would love to use it at night as the direction suggest, but I use a Vitamin A serum, thus I cannot use this. Also, worth noting that my skin is sensitive and I cannot tolerate many vitamin C products. This product is hefty in price, but I will keep repurchasing.

I've used this for about 4-5 months now and I can visible see the difference in the tone smoothness and overall brightness of my face. It's such a food formulation. I wear it everyday religiously with spf on top and the. My daily makeup over it. On the days I do t wear anything on my face I've still gotten compliments about the glow. Love this product. Almost done with my first bottle and waiting to get my next. You must wear it everyday to see the results. A little goes a long way.

I love this product line but I believe it is wasted on more youthful skin. Especially wasted on those women who have a problem with the alleged smell. Women of sensitive skin should not use this product. If you're in your fabulous 50's and you need to refresh what time has slowly taken from you, the Potent C line of products will roll back the clock at least 5 years in a month. Moderately priced. A little goes a long way. I love Peter Thomas Roth Skincare.
This product burn my skin and left small pimples under it .now when I wear make up my skin looks rough and not soft, I want my skin back😞

I had dark spots under my eyes a long patch following my under eyes on both sides. I made me very insecure and I decided on this product. The dark spots are gone and my face has such a smooth appearance. I really like this product. It is worth the money to me. It has a smokey/wood type smell. I don't mind it but it is a stronger smell.
odd smell that thankfully doesn't last long. can't tell that it is doing anything and to be such a high percentage of vitamin c, there is no tingle. I'll use it up but then go back to The Ordinary.

I have been using this serum for about 3 weeks. I am also using the face wash and moisturizer. My skin is glowing and even toned. My skin has not felt this good in years. I was using Farmacy products before this but I like this brand better.

Used this every night for a month... Nothing. Maybe made my skin softer? Vitamin C should start to work in about 3 weeks to a month. So glad I didn't buy it full price but I kind of want my money back... Also the whole thing lasts maybe 6 weeks for me? Disappointed to say the least.

I have been using this product for approximately three months now. my daughter works for a dermatologist and said that I needed to start using vitamin C serum so I did. I researched and decided on this product. I religiously put it on every morning and the other day I looked at myself in the mirror and wow! The lines around my eyes are almost nonexistent and I am 58 years old. I absolutely love what this is doing for my skin. So happy I found this product

What I learned about Vitamin C is that it works best when used alone, no other actives applied on the face before or after the Vitamin C, well for me. The product states that is is a serum but it has a oily finish that I don't care for. It is slowly improving the texture and discoloration left behind my long bout of cystic acne. The smell is present but doesn't bother me. I rather deal with no added scents or essential oils because those make my skin breakout in an itchy rash. I am on the fence in repurchasing because I want to try Drunk Elephant Vitamin C serum.

avis.titre: Most amazing skin care product ever!
avis.texte: I cannot rave about this product enough. I have struggled with acne, sensitive skin, redness, texture from picking acne as a teen, etc. This is the first product ever that has helped with everything "wrong" with my skin. I have been using it consistently for about a month & my skin looks SO much better. I finally feel okay going outside my home without a drop of makeup on. Each week it just gets better & better. I will warn you that you'll want to start with using this just once a day. It did give me some dryness & peeling the first week of use & some small acne bumps. After that first week though I had no further issues & I increased to using twice a day after two weeks. I have no idea why there are so many complaints about the smell. I think it smells like you'd expect a vitamin c product to smell, it isn't bad nor very strong to me. This stuff seriously works, you won't regret using it. Just remember to give it a chance to work, you can't quit after just 3 days & expect the amazing results.

I am lost on all these smelly issues. I am blind and have hypersensitive sense of smell. I've read the smells of hot dog water to Tar and plastic, which all smell significantly different. Which is it? I smell vitamin C; a very mild orange very lite fragrance. Definitely not a deal breaker. When my very flaky, dry, sensitive, mature skin with lesions from cystic acne is now more balanced than it's ever been and I'm 51 years old. It is a little on the greasy side temporarily which is why I use it only at night about 30 min before bedtime. I use water drench for daytime. If you have time on you're hands with patience you can use it during the day. You'd need to apply about an hour before makeup to fully absorb. It was the only product that allowed me to exit my home with less breakouts. The breakouts turned to lesions that freaked people out. This product gave me a ticket out of hiding and I'm thankful.
